About Trust Issues: Lying Signs

Trust Issues: Lying Signs is a funny troll platformer where every sign lies! Safe path leads to spikes, No key needed means you need the key, and the exit door might eat you. Beat 25 tricky levels across unique worlds full of surprise traps: fake floors, saws, cannons and sneaky enemies. Collect stars, earn coins and unlock skins. Hard but fair. Just stop trusting the signs!

How to play

PC Arrow keys A-D to move Space W Up Arrow to jump P or Esc to pause R to restart H for hint Mobile Tap the on-screen arrow buttons to move and the JUMP button to jump
